title: number
description: A measured number: a ledger claim reference {claim, field?}, or (only when claims are not required) a literal {value, unit?, source?}.

claim.description: ledger claim id, optionally pinned with @vN

field.description: field of the claim to cite, e.g. distribution.median (default: value)

source.description: where the number came from (free text; recorded as unverified)
